evidence: R4 code lives under quant-lab/execution_runtime/tb/ (new package) and quant-lab/execution_runtime/tests/test_execution_runtime_r4_*.py (new tests).
Canonical TB sources (quant-lab/engines/*, quant-lab/tb_live/*, quant-lab/runtime/*) were READ-ONLY; git status shows no modification to them.

The generic harness writes only to a temp/in-memory SQLite path (RuntimeStore db_path) and an in-memory SimBrokerSession; it never opens quant-lab/state, tb_control.db, tb_runtime.db, pid files, or the desired-state file.
No MetaTrader5 module is imported by the execution_runtime runtime or the tb harness (reference path is a pure port in tb/reference.py).
conclusion: R4 did not write active TB state, did not mutate Task Scheduler, and did not touch the live broker.
